name: Bộ Công an foreigner tạm trú declaration portal (KBTT)

fill_login.description: Set the Ant Design login inputs form_item_username and form_item_password with the native value setter plus input/change events. Returns booleans only, never echoes a value; the caller supplies values from its own secret store.

captcha_image.description: Base64 (no data: prefix) of the visible data:image captcha img wider than 100px, or null when none is on the page.

history_range.description: On history-declare-manager: open the range picker on the "Ngày bắt đầu" input, click the from and to date cells (paging months as needed), then click "Tìm kiếm". No in-page timers.

history_rows.description: History table rows (.ant-table-tbody tr) as arrays of cell text, skipping the empty-state row.

print_row_pdf.description: Click the print button on the first history row whose text contains match, then read the blob PDF from the XEM TRƯỚC modal and close it. Re-callable: returns {status:"pending"} until the iframe exists; call again with the same args.
